shadowSentences: I love reading books in my free time.
My favorite season is autumn because of the colors.
I often go hiking with my friends on weekends.
Cooking new recipes can be really fun and rewarding.
Traveling to new places helps broaden my perspective.
I enjoy learning about different cultures through travel.
Listening to music can improve my mood significantly.
Doing volunteer work helps me feel connected to my community.
Taking regular breaks while studying leads to better focus.
Maintaining a balanced diet is important for my overall health.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eating habits.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your daily eating habits?
Q2: What challenges do you face when trying to eat healthy?
Q3: What is your opinion on the importance of nutrition?
Q4: What advice would you give someone wanting to improve their diet?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What types of exercise do you enjoy the most?
Q2: How do you stay motivated to maintain an exercise routine?
Q3: In your opinion, how important is regular exercise for health?
Q4: What tips would you offer someone starting to exercise?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about environmental awareness.
questions: Q1: Can you share how you try to be environmentally friendly?
Q2: What challenges do people face in adopting eco-friendly practices?
Q3: What do you think about the current state of environmental protection?
Q4: What actions would you recommend for someone wanting to help the environment?
